## 🏁 v1.0 — Five weapons + gamepad pilot

First stable release of the XRP master software for **Team Robots Legends** (FUSAMO, XRP Iron Acres).

### What is inside
- **Weapon 1 — Gyro-Lock PID**: IMU heading keeper (KP/KI/KD), kills post-crash spins.
- **Weapon 2 — Torque Boost**: anti-stall effort injection when the robot pushes hard.
- **Weapon 3 — Cubic curves + slew**: kid-friendly stick shaping (precision zone + smooth ramps).
- **Weapon 4 — Traction & Active Brake**: the ONLY motor writer; active braking, anti-nailed pulses.
- **Weapon 5 — Endgame clock**: 150,000 ms match clock + odometry X,Y,θ + automatic return home in the last 12 s.
- **Pilot**: real gamepad at 50 Hz, pilot profiles (KID / GOOD / REGULAR / ADULT), no one-button macros.
- **Simulation suite**: `verify` (12 unit tests), `stress` (30 crash matches), `mass_campaign`, `games` (DRIVE/SUMO/SOCCER).
- **CI**: GitHub Actions battery with 13 fixed thresholds; tests are NEVER edited, only pilot/weapons are.

### Iron rules honored
1. Everything runs ON the board — no internet, no API during a match.
2. No `time.sleep()` — `ticks_ms` + `uasyncio` only.
3. Continuous sensor-reactive assistance only (no one-button macros).
